This is `/atticus-stories` under its old name (ADR 0119); it goes away in a later version.

Do exactly what `/atticus-stories $ARGUMENTS` does: run `atticus stories $ARGUMENTS --handoff` and follow what it prints, looping with Atticus's checks until the stage is done. Tell the person to use `/atticus-stories` from now on.
